chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ḥātim, from Ḥumayd ibn Ziyād, said: ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Aḥmad al-Nahīkī narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Khadījah, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
When the month of Ramadan entered, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would increase in salat (prayer); so I increase, therefore increase.

key_terms.أَزِيدُ: I increase, referring to adding more worship
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the act of ritual worship being increased
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, whose practice is being described
key_terms.شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the sacred month in which worship is increased
key_terms.فَزِيدُوا: so increase, an instruction to do more worship

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about increasing salat (prayer) in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to increase his salat (prayer) when Ramadan began. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام then states that he also increases, urging others to do likewise, showing the recommended increase of worship in this month.
